title: The Last Signal
author: W. M. Lockridge
blurb: Coral Thackeray, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
